actions.rulesText: Place a Copy into an empty space within range. 3+: Place a Copy into an empty space within range. 5+: Place a Copy into an empty space within range. 7+: Each of your Copies may Move up to 3.

actions.name: …Now You Don't
actions.rulesText: Swap spaces with one of your Copies. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Wormhole
actions.rulesText: Place a Pit into your own space. 4+: Place 1 Pit into an empty space you can see.

actions.name: Black Hole
actions.rulesText: Target 1 empty space within range. Place a Pit into that space, then target someone within range and Pull them 2 towards the Pit.

actions.name: Tough It Out
actions.rulesText: Pay 1 HP, then gain a 3 point Shield. 9+: You instead pay 2 HP and instead gain a 7-point Shield.

actions.name: Jab
actions.rulesText: You cannot use Jab unless you have a Shield with value 2+. Push 1 and deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Show Off
actions.rulesText: Choose X: Move 1; -or- Pull 1 to an enemy you can see; -or-deal 1 damage to an enemy within range; -or-give 1 Burning token to an enemy within range; -or-give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range; -or-give 1 Fatigue token to an enemy within range; -or-Challenge an enemy within range; -or-push 1 to an enemy within range; -or- gain 1 Iron token; -or-gain 1 Power token; -or- gain 1 Speed token; -or-heal 1; -or- gain Shield 1. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Slugfest
actions.rulesText: Move 1, then Challenge an enemy within range, then they deal 1 damage to you. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Weapon Throw
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage and give 1 Burning Token to an enemy you can see, then Disable your current Weapon until your next turn and choose a new one to take effect.

actions.name: Slice & Smash
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to up to 2 enemies within range. 5+: Deal 2 damage and Push 1 instead. 8+: Deal 3 damage and Push 2 instead. 11+: Deal 4 damage and Push 3 instead.

actions.name: Is That All You Got?
actions.rulesText: Challenge an enemy you can see. You gain 1 Iron token. 6+: Challenge another enemy you can see, then gain 2 Iron tokens and heal 2. 12+: Challenge a third enemy you can see, then give each of those enemies 3 Weakness tokens and Push 2.

actions.name: Not Good Enough
actions.rulesText: This Action costs your Challenge token held by an enemy within range. You must discard one such token to pay for Not Good Enough. Not Good Enough targets the enemy who held the Challenge Token you spent to pay for Not Good Enough. Give them 2 Weakness tokens. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Leave My Student Alone
actions.rulesText: Pull 2 and Challenge an enemy you can see. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Show You How It’s Done
actions.rulesText: Target a Unique Dice Action available to someone’s current Stance in this fight, other than Show You How It’s Done or an Action you targeted earlier during this turn. Perform that Action. For the purposes of Gates or the value of X, use a value of 4.

actions.name: Diabolical Plan
actions.rulesText: You teleport 2 and gain 1 Chaos Token. 9+: You teleport 2 and gain 1 more Chaos Token.

actions.name: Take Your Time
actions.rulesText: You gain 2 Iron tokens and 1 Mentor Token. Other Actions cannot be used to perform Take Your Time.

actions.name: Watch Closely
actions.rulesText: You gain 1 Training Token. 6+: You gain 1 Training Token. 9+: You gain 1 Training Token.

actions.name: Welcome To My Maze
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage and Pull 3 to an enemy you can see.

actions.name: Rat Trap
actions.rulesText: Rat Trap can be used as either a Dice or Token Action. Deal 1 damage and give 2 Fatigue tokens to each adjacent enemy. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Ghost Walk
actions.rulesText: Place a Fog obstacle into an empty space within range. Then, teleport to an empty space both within Fog and within range.

actions.name: Reflections of the Self
actions.rulesText: Place a Copy into an empty space within range, then gain 2 Iron tokens. 6+: Place a Copy into an empty space within range, then gain 2 Iron tokens.

actions.name: Shatter
actions.rulesText: Target one of your Copies. It deals 1 damage to each enemy within its range. At the end of this turn, destroy that Copy. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Take Cover
actions.rulesText: Place a Wall into an empty adjacent space. 5+: Place up to three more Walls into empty spaces within range, then gain 2 Iron tokens.

actions.name: From Above!
actions.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Grapple Hook
actions.rulesText: Grapple Hook can be used as either a Dice or Token Action. Choose one or both: An ally within range teleports to an empty space within your range of their choice; -and/or- you teleport to an empty space within range.

actions.name: Roughhousing
actions.rulesText: As an additional cost, you may pay 2 or 4 Basic Tokens. Choose one: Place Rubble into up to 3 adjacent spaces; -or-Pull 1 and deal 1 damage to up to two enemies within range; -or-Move 3 and deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy. 2 Basic Tokens: Choose two instead. 4 Basic Tokens: Choose three instead.

actions.name: Flare

cost.text: 1+ or 5+ or 3 Basic Tokens or 6 Basic Tokens

actions.rulesText: Flare can be paid for as either a Dice Action or a Token Action. Move 2, then give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range. 5+ -or- 6 Basic Tokens: Give them 2 more Weakness tokens, give them 2 Burning tokens, then Challenge them.

actions.name: Slip Up
actions.rulesText: Move 2. 2 HP: Push 2 to someone within range, then Move 1. 3 HP: Deal 1 damage to someone within range, then Move 1. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Bad Luck
actions.rulesText: Place X Traps into empty spaces within range. Usable once per turn. X cannot be greater than 4.

actions.name: Karma
actions.rulesText: Deal X damage and give 4 Weakness tokens to the active character. X is equal to the amount of HP you have lost this turn. Usable once per turn. Usable only during enemy turns.

actions.name: Think Fast!
actions.rulesText: Target an enemy within range and Choose one: Give them 1 Weakness token; -or- give them 1 Fatigue token; -or- Push 3. Then, you may Move 2. 4 Basic Tokens: Choose two instead. 5 Basic Tokens: Choose three instead.

actions.name: Poetry In Motion
actions.rulesText: Move 1 and gain 1 Iron token. 4+: Move up to 2, gain 1 Iron token, and gain 1 Power token. 7+: Move up to 3, gain 1 Iron token, and gain 1 Power token.

actions.name: Power Strike
actions.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, then you gain 2 Power tokens. 8+: Deal 4 damage and gain 4 Power tokens instead.

actions.name: Hey.
actions.rulesText: Challenge an enemy within range. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Nothing Personal
actions.rulesText: This Action costs your Challenge token held by an enemy within range. You must discard one such token to pay for Nothing Personal. Nothing Personal targets the enemy who held the Challenge Token you spent to pay for Nothing Personal. Teleport to an empty space adjacent to that target, then deal 1 damage to them. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Deadly Dance
actions.rulesText: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range. 4+: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range. 6+: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range. 8+: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Swift Strike
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to an enemy within range. Usable once per turn, only during enemy turns.

actions.name: Effortless
actions.rulesText: Teleport to an empty space you can see. 6+: Choose an ally within range. They may teleport to an empty space they can see.

actions.name: Walled In
actions.rulesText: Place up to 3 Walls into empty spaces within Range 1-3. 6+: Place up to 3 Walls into empty spaces within Range 1-3, then you may swap spaces with one Wall placed by Walled In.

actions.name: Icicle Fall
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to each enemy adjacent to any Walls. 7+: Deal 2 damage instead, then give 1 Weakness token to each enemy dealt damage by Icicle Fall.

actions.name: Splintered Mirror
actions.rulesText: Place a Copy into an empty space within range. You may swap spaces with that Copy.

actions.name: Crystal Spike
actions.rulesText: Target one enemy within range. Deal 1 damage to them and give them 1 Weakness token. 7+: Deal 2 more damage and give 2 more Weakness tokens.

actions.name: Exploit Weakness
actions.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. You may spend Weakness tokens they hold as if they were Power tokens you hold. 7+: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. You may spend Weakness tokens they hold as if they were Power tokens you hold.

actions.name: Ice Block
actions.rulesText: Gain 3 Iron tokens, then give 1 Weakness token to all adjacent enemies.

actions.name: Block This
actions.rulesText: An enemy within range gains 1 Iron token, then you deal 4 damage to them. Unblockable by Iron Tokens. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Heart Strike
actions.rulesText: An enemy within range pays 2 HP and gains 1 Weakness token. 7+: That enemy pays 2 more HP and gains 2 Weakness tokens.

actions.name: Build Pressure
actions.rulesText: Give an enemy within range 1 each of three different Status tokens of your choice (Burning, Challenge, Fatigue, or Weakness).

actions.name: Apply Pressure
actions.rulesText: Target an enemy within range. Deal damage to them equal to the number of Status tokens they hold, to a max of 12 damage. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Slide In
actions.rulesText: Teleport 2. 4+: Teleport 2 more, then you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Left, Right!
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to an enemy within range, then you may Move 1, then you deal 2 more damage to that enemy.

actions.name: Dance Together
actions.rulesText: Choose someone within range. Pull them 1, then you Move 1, then you Pull them 1 more. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Tango
actions.rulesText: Swap spaces with an adjacent enemy, then Push them 1. 6+: Pull them 2, then deal 2 damage to them. 10+: Push them 4, then deal 3 damage to them.

actions.name: Dance Apart
actions.rulesText: Push 3 to someone within range, then Move 1. 7+: Move 2 more, then heal.

actions.name: Blossoms
actions.rulesText: You gain Shield 2 and choose one: Gain 1 Power token; -or-Move 1; -or- heal 1. 6+: Instead, gain Shield 4 and choose two.

actions.name: Brambles
actions.rulesText: This is a Token Action that costs your Shield. Deal 1 damage to up to X enemies within Range 1-X, then gain 1 Power token. X is equal to the value of the destroyed Shield. Usable twice per turn.

actions.name: Confident Smirk
actions.rulesText: Unblockable. Gain 1 Power token and heal 1.

actions.name: Burning Fist
actions.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, then give them Burning Tokens equal to the damage dealt to them by Burning Fist.

actions.name: Bow Down
actions.rulesText: Give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range. 4+: Give 1 Weakness token to each enemy within range.

actions.name: Stand Strong
actions.rulesText: 1+: Give 1 Power token to an ally within range. 3+: Heal that ally. 5+: Heal and give 1 Power token to a different ally within range. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.rulesText: Pull yourself 3 towards an enemy you can see. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Howl
actions.rulesText: Gain 1 Power token, then heal 4, then give 1 Weakness token to each enemy you can see. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Suppression
actions.rulesText: You gain 1 Control token and may Move 1. 6+: You gain 1 Control token and may Move 1. 9+: You gain 1 Control token and may Move 1.

actions.name: Secure
actions.rulesText: Choose two: Gain 2 Iron tokens; -or- an ally within range other than yourself gains 2 Iron tokens; -or- give Shield 2 to an ally within range.

actions.name: Contain
actions.rulesText: Target an enemy within range, then Choose two: Challenge them; -or- Give them 2 Fatigue tokens; -or- place a Trap into their space.

actions.name: Protect
actions.rulesText: Choose four from the Secure and Contain lists. Options from the Contain list must target an enemy within range.

actions.name: Beyond Human
actions.rulesText: Choose one: You Heal 2; -or- you gain 2 Power tokens; -or-discard up to 4 Status tokens among allies within range; -or-you gain Shield 3. 6+: Choose two instead. 9+: Choose three instead. 11+: Choose all four instead.

actions.name: Strut Your Stuff
actions.rulesText: Pull yourself 4 towards the active character. Then, if they are an enemy, deal 1 damage to them. If they are an ally, give them 1 Iron token. Cannot be used on your own turn.

actions.name: Palm Strike
actions.rulesText: Push 3 and deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.

actions.name: Say Hello To My Secret Weapon
actions.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to an enemy within range. Usable once per fight.

actions.name: Stunt
actions.rulesText: Place one Fog, Copy, Pit, or Trap obstacle into an adjacent space, then teleport 2. During enemy turns: usable once per turn.

actions.name: Siren Song
actions.rulesText: Challenge one enemy you can see. You may Pull them up to 3. 5+: Challenge every enemy adjacent to the initial target, then Pull 1 to everyone Challenged by Siren Song.

actions.name: First Aid
actions.rulesText: Target an ally within Range 1-5. Pull yourself towards them, 1 space at a time, until you are adjacent to that ally. 4+: Heal that ally. 6+: Give that ally Shield 4. First Aid can only target an ally once per turn.

actions.name: XYZ-BURST
actions.rulesText: You may pay for XYZ-BURST using 2, 3, 4, or 5 Basic Tokens. You heal X, then teleport Y, then deal Z damage to an enemy within range. X is equal to the number of Iron tokens spent to pay for this. Y is equal to twice the number of Speed tokens spent. Z is equal to the number of Power tokens spent. Usable once per turn, only during your own turn.

actions.name: Devil Dive
actions.rulesText: Teleport 3, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Incinerate
actions.rulesText: Deal 1 damage and give 1 Burning token to an enemy within range. 5+: Deal 2 damage and give 2 Burning tokens instead. 8+: Deal 3 damage and give 3 Burning tokens instead.

actions.name: Grape Shot
actions.rulesText: This is a Gunslinger Action. Deal 1 damage to up to four enemies within range. Any target that takes 0 damage from Grape Shot is pushed 1 space.

actions.name: Slug Shot
actions.rulesText: This is a Gunslinger Action. Push 4 and deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Telekinesis
actions.rulesText: Choose one: Push 3 to an enemy or obstacle within range; -or-Pull 3 to an enemy or obstacle within range. If this movement ends with an enemy and an obstacle sharing a space, you deal 1 damage to that enemy. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: I'm Still Here
actions.rulesText: Push 4 and deal 4 damage to an enemy within range. 13+: Push 7 and deal 7 damage instead.

actions.name: Remember Your Training
actions.rulesText: The active character heals 1, then performs a Unique Action available to their current Stance, without paying its cost. For the purposes of Gates or the value of X, use a value of 4. Usable once per turn, only during allies’ turns. Usable while you are Taken Out.

actions.name: Bag Of Tricks
actions.rulesText: Bag of Tricks can be used as either a Dice Action or a Token Action. To pay for Bag of Tricks, choose one or more: Spend a 2+ and 1 HP; -or-Spend a 3+; -or- spend 2 Iron tokens; -or- spend 3 Speed tokens; -or- pay 3 HP. X is equal to the number of costs paid. Choose X: Create a Copy within range and swap spaces with it; -or-Create a Pit Trap in an empty space within range; -or-Move up to 2, then swap spaces with an obstacle within range; -or-Pull 3 to an enemy you can see and they discard 1 token; -or-Give 2 Weakness tokens to an enemy within range. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Just What I Needed
actions.rulesText: Choose one: Teleport 3; -or- Push 2 and deal 2 damage to an enemy within range; -or- you gain temporary Armor. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: War Dance
actions.rulesText: Move 1, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range. 5+: Move 2, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. 9+: Move 3, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Frostbite
actions.rulesText: Give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range. 3+: Give 1 Weakness token to a different enemy within range. 5+: Give 1 Weakness token to up to two enemies within range. 8+: Give 1 Weakness token to up to three enemies within range.

actions.name: Unseen Step
actions.rulesText: Teleport X.

actions.name: Crush
actions.rulesText: Unblockable by Abilities and Tokens. Deal 3 damage to an enemy within range. 9+: Deal 5 damage instead, and Crush is Unblockable.

actions.name: Unseen Step
actions.rulesText: Teleport X.

actions.name: Synchro Breaker
actions.rulesText: Target an adjacent enemy and Disable all of their Abilities until the end of this turn.

actions.name: Arise, My Minion!
actions.rulesText: Create a Copy in an empty space within range. Both you and that Copy may Move 1. Usable once per turn.

actions.name: En Masse
actions.rulesText: Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space. 3+: Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space. 5+: Swap spaces with a Copy within range, then Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space. 7+: Swap spaces with a Copy within range, then Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space.

actions.name: Unseen Step
actions.rulesText: Teleport X.

actions.name: Controlling
actions.rulesText: You gain 1 Control Token. 5+ You gain 1 more Control Token.

actions.name: Rapid Strike
actions.rulesText: Move one space, then deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.

abilities.name: Blaster Form
abilities.rulesText: Your Actions may apply to one extra target within range. When you add Blaster Form to a Style, increase that Style's maximum range by 1.

abilities.name: Control Form
abilities.rulesText: After you spend Control Tokens, you may Push 1 or Pull 1 to the enemy whose Action you Controlled. When you add Control Form to a Style, choose one: • Increase that Style's maximum range by 3. • Set that Style's minimum range to 0.

abilities.name: Dance Form
abilities.rulesText: (Forced Movement is any Push or Pull effect) . After you take damage, pay HP, or are healed, you gain 1 Speed token. When you Bleed, gain 3 Speed tokens. After each Dice Action you perform, if it applied Forced Movement to an enemy, they must discard 1 Basic token, if they have any. If it applied Forced Movement to an ally, they heal 1. If it moved, swapped, or teleported you, you heal 1.

abilities.name: Iron Form
abilities.rulesText: You have Armor. When your Armor triggers, you gain 1 Iron token. When you gain Speed tokens, replace half of them (rounded down) with Iron tokens. You may spend 1 Iron token to take 1 less damage from any source (even Reduced Hits).

abilities.name: One-Two Form
abilities.rulesText: Before each Action you perform, you may Move 1. After your first Action on your turn, Move 1, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. At the end of each turn where you performed any Actions, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within range, then Move 2.

abilities.name: Power Form
abilities.rulesText: When you gain Speed tokens, replace half of them (rounded down) with Power tokens. You can Enhance a Hit two additional times.

abilities.name: Reversal Form
abilities.rulesText: You have Armor. Unblockable by Control Tokens and Iron Tokens. The first time your Armor triggers each turn, you may Teleport 2. Then, if your Action Pool is empty, add a 3 to your Action Pool.

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you gain 2 Speed tokens. At the start of each Movement Phase, you may Move 1. You do not discard any Speed tokens during the End Phase.

abilities.name: Song Form
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, choose your song: Iron, Power, or Speed. You gain 3 tokens of the chosen type, and each ally (other than yourself) gains 1 token of the chosen type.

abilities.name: Thorns Form
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you gain Shield 2. After your Shield absorbs from an enemy Action, you deal 1 damage to them. If it broke your Shield, you deal 2 damage instead.

abilities.name: Vigilance Form
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, discard up to 2 Status tokens you hold; then, if you are Bleeding, you heal. At the end of your turn, choose up to two enemies within range and give them each 1 Weakness token.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.rulesText: After each Action you perform, if you are not Bleeding, you pay 1 HP. At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Power tokens. When you Bleed, add a 4 to your Action Pool.

abilities.name: Halcyon Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you may discard one token you hold. After you discard tokens using an Action or Ability, you gain an equal number of Iron tokens.

abilities.name: Judgment Style
abilities.rulesText: When an enemy with your Challenge token starts their turn, they do not roll their lowest Action Die. It is discarded and unused. If they are in a Stance that does not roll Action Dice, they get rid of their bonus die, if they have one, or their smallest number, if they do not. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, all numbers currently in their Action Pool are reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Shining Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, Push 1 to all obstacles and enemies adjacent to you. Enemies cannot use Action Movement, Free Movement, or teleports to enter a space adjacent to you. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, the enemy who held the token takes 3 damage.

abilities.name: Singing Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, choose a Mood: Despair, Sorrow, or Rage. If you picked Despair, give 1 Fatigue token to all enemies. If you picked Sorrow, give 1 Weakness token to all enemies. If you picked Rage, give 1 Burning token to all enemies.

abilities.name: Winged Style
abilities.rulesText: You do not take Fall Damage. Rubble does not give you Fatigue tokens. At the end of every turn, you may move 1 space. After you give an enemy your Challenge token, you may Move 2.

abilities.name: Charging Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain temporary Armor and may Move up to 2. At the start of each ally's turn, that ally may Move up to 2.

abilities.name: Heroic Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you heal 1. Whenever an ally within range takes damage, they take half that damage (rounded down) and you take the other half (rounded up).

abilities.name: Jumping Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you may Teleport 3. When you Bleed, you may Teleport 3.

abilities.name: Rallying Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each ally's turn, if they are within Range of you or your Copies, they may heal. At the end of your turn, choose an ally you can see other than yourself. They heal and gain Shield 2.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Style
abilities.rulesText: Your allies within range may spend your tokens. At the start and end of your turn, give 1 Iron token to each ally within range.

abilities.name: Armored Style
abilities.rulesText: After you spend Iron tokens or trigger your Armor, you heal 1. This can heal a maximum of 3 HP per turn. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, the enemy who held the token gains 2 Weakness tokens.

abilities.name: Incinerator Style
abilities.rulesText: After you use a Power token to Enhance a Hit, give 1 Burning token to the target of that hit. After you take damage from Burning Tokens, gain 1 Power token.

abilities.name: Machine Style
abilities.rulesText: Machine Style Range: 1-2 Preparation At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Iron token. You may spend your Iron Tokens as if they were Power tokens or Speed tokens.

abilities.name: Rocket Style
abilities.rulesText: After you Push, you may Teleport to an empty space adjacent to the target of that Push. At the start of your turn, you may Push 3 to an obstacle, ally, or enemy within range.

abilities.name: Syphon Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you may choose 1 token you hold. Either replace it with a Power token, or gain another copy of it.

abilities.name: Dark Style
abilities.rulesText: You can see and target enemies through Fog. At the end of your turn, place a Fog obstacle into your space.

abilities.name: Ogre's Style
abilities.rulesText: Your Throws may target any number of enemies within range. After you perform an Action that inflicted Forced Movement on any enemies, you deal 1 damage to each enemy moved by that Action.

abilities.name: Slasher Style
abilities.rulesText: After an effect Pushes you, you may Pull yourself up to 2 towards the source of that Push. At the end of every turn, you may Move 1, then you deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.

abilities.name: Vampire Style
abilities.rulesText: After you deal damage with an Action or Ability, you heal 1. This Ability cannot heal you more than the Bleed Value in a single turn. After you give Weakness tokens to an enemy, you gain 1 Power token, to a maximum of 4 Power tokens per turn.

abilities.name: Zombie Style
abilities.rulesText: After an enemy destroys any of your Copies, you deal 1 damage to them. At the start of your turn and when you Bleed, place a Copy into a space within range of you or your Copies. At the end of your turn, you deal 1 damage to each enemy adjacent to any of your Copies.

abilities.name: Blazing Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each allied turn, give 1 Burning token to each enemy within range.

abilities.name: Explosion Style
abilities.rulesText: After you perform an Action that destroyed any obstacles, deal 1 damage to all enemies on or adjacent to any of those obstacles.

abilities.name: Inferno Style
abilities.rulesText: You have Armor against damage from Burning tokens. After you Reduce a Hit, give 1 Burning token to your attacker.

abilities.name: Phoenix Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain Shield 2, then if you are Bleeding, you heal. When you Bleed, you heal and gain Shield 3. You do not take damage from Burning Tokens.

abilities.name: Volcanic Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you may place a Trap into a space within range. After an enemy within range takes damage from a Trap, give that enemy 1 Burning token. You do not take damage from Traps.

abilities.name: Akimbo Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, Move 2. After each Action you perform, Move 1.

abilities.name: Crosshair Style
abilities.rulesText: Whenever you deal 3 or more damage to an enemy in a single hit, they gain 1 Weakness token and you gain 1 Power token.

abilities.name: Fullmetal Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, choose your Ammo: Incendiary, Toxin, or Tracer. You have the chosen Ammo effect until your next turn. Incendiary: After each damage-dealing Action you perform, give each enemy dealt damage by that Action 1 Burning token. Toxin: After each damage-dealing Action you perform, give each enemy dealt damage by that Action 1 Weakness token. Tracer: You can see and target enemies through Fog and Walls. You have +2 maximum Range.

abilities.name: Quickdraw Style
abilities.rulesText: Add d6 to your Action Dice. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, the enemy who held the token gains 2 Fatigue tokens.

abilities.name: Ricochet Style
abilities.rulesText: After each Action you perform, you may choose one: deal 1 damage to one enemy within range that was not targeted by that Action; -or- replace one obstacle you can see with Rubble.

abilities.name: Aura Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain Shield 3. After an enemy within range damages or breaks an ally’s Shield, or has their own Shield damaged or broken, you may Push 1 or Pull 1 to that enemy. After a Shield within range breaks, you gain 1 Power token.

abilities.name: Crying Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, give 1 Weakness token to all enemies within range. At the end of your turn, Challenge an enemy within range and give them 1 Weakness token. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, the enemy who held it gains 3 Burning tokens.

abilities.name: Puppet's Style
abilities.rulesText: After each space you move using Free Movement, you may Move 1 to one ally or obstacle within range. Obstacles you move with this Ability become Rubble. At the end of your turn, each enemy that moved this turn takes 1 damage, and each ally that moved this turn heals 2.

abilities.name: Spirit Style
abilities.rulesText: You and your Copies do not take damage from Pits or Traps. You and your Copies treat Walls as if they were Rubble. After each space of Free Movement you do, any number of your Copies may Move 1.

abilities.name: Vortex Style
abilities.rulesText: You do not take damage from Pits. When you are standing on a Pit, every other Pit counts as an adjacent space you can move to. Your range is still calculated only from the space you are currently standing in.

abilities.name: Brawling Style
abilities.rulesText: At the end of each turn you took damage, you gain Shield 2. After your Shield absorbs, you gain 1 Power token.

abilities.name: Flashy Style
abilities.rulesText: After you roll your Action Dice, you may combine two of your numbers into a single, larger number. Then, you may split one of your numbers in half (one rounded up, the other rounded down). You cannot split a 1 - the split number must be 2 or higher.

abilities.name: Knockdown Style
abilities.rulesText: After you take damage from an Action, you deal 1 damage to each enemy that dealt damage to you. If that enemy holds your Challenge, you deal 2 damage to them instead.

abilities.name: Mad Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, choose a Weapon: Club, Knife, or Pistol. You have the chosen Weapon’s effect until your next turn. Club: After each damage-dealing Action you perform, give each enemy dealt damage by that Action one Fatigue token. Knife: Your Actions and Abilities are Unblockable by Armor and Tokens. Pistol: You have +3 maximum Range.

abilities.name: Taunting Style
abilities.rulesText: After you take damage, you gain 1 Iron token. After you take damage from an enemy with your Challenge, you may Move 1. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, you gain 2 Iron tokens.

abilities.name: Decoy Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each enemy turn, you may pay 1 HP to Challenge the active character. After you Challenge an enemy, you deal 2 damage to them. If an enemy discards your Challenge token using an enemy Action or Ability, heal your nearest ally to them, other than yourself.

abilities.name: Elder Style
abilities.rulesText: The cost of all Actions you perform are reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1+ or 2 tokens/HP/Shield). The damage values of all Actions you perform are reduced by 1 (to a minimum of zero).

abilities.name: Mastermind Style
abilities.rulesText: You cannot perform Actions. Instead, you pay their costs, but make your allies perform them for you. Each Action you take uses an ally's current location, range, and Stance bonuses as if they'd taken that Action themselves. You can only give Actions to allies you can see. After each Action an ally performs during your turn, you may Move 1.

abilities.name: Patient Style
abilities.rulesText: You have Armor. At the end of each allied turn, you gain 1 Iron token. After you use Armor or Iron tokens to reduce the damage you would take, one ally you can see other than yourself may heal 1.

abilities.name: Training Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Training Token, then one ally you can see (other than yourself) heals 2 and gains 2 Power tokens. After you spend a Training Token, give 1 Training Token to an ally you can see, other than yourself.

abilities.name: Caged Style
abilities.rulesText: Adjacent enemies cannot gain or spend Speed tokens, and any Action Movement they would take is reduced to zero.

abilities.name: Hidden Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, place Fog into your space. While you stand in Fog, you have Armor and your maximum range is increased by 3.

abilities.name: Mirrored Style
abilities.rulesText: After you spend Iron tokens, you may deal 1 damage to one enemy within range of you or your Copies. Your Copies have 2 HP each. You may spend Iron tokens to Reduce Hits to your Copies.

abilities.name: Parkour Style
abilities.rulesText: You may move through and stand on top of Walls as though they were empty spaces. You can see and target enemies through Walls. After you end movement within a Wall’s space, you may Move 1.

abilities.name: Whip Style
abilities.rulesText: Your Throw Actions may target within range. After you Throw or Grapple an enemy, you deal 2 damage to them.

abilities.name: Collateral Style
abilities.rulesText: After you deal damage to an enemy with an Action, you may destroy 1 obstacle within range per enemy dealt damage. At the end of your turn, you gain 1 Power token per obstacle you destroyed during that turn.

abilities.name: Distracting Style
abilities.rulesText: After an enemy deals damage to you with an Action, give that enemy 1 Weakness token. Your Challenge tokens cannot be discarded by enemy Actions or Abilities.

abilities.name: Lucky Style
abilities.rulesText: Add d4 to your Action Dice. You have Armor.

abilities.name: Misfortune's Style
abilities.rulesText: After you take damage from anything other than an Action or an Ability, choose one: You deal 1 damage to an enemy within range; -or- you heal 2.

abilities.name: Scrambling Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Power token and 1 Iron token. After you spend Power tokens, you gain 1 Speed token. After you spend Iron tokens, you gain 1 Speed token. When you discard Speed tokens at the end of each turn, you do not discard below 2 Speed tokens.

abilities.name: Artistic Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Iron tokens. After you deal damage to, or Reduce a Hit from, an enemy, you may spend 1 Iron token to give them 1 Status token of your choice.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Style
abilities.rulesText: Your Actions and Abilities are Unblockable by Armor. At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Power tokens. After an enemy deals damage to you with an Action, you may spend a Power token to deal 1 damage and Push 1 to your attacker.

abilities.name: Relentless Style
abilities.rulesText: Enemies holding your Challenge are within your range. After you deal damage, Push 1.

abilities.name: Swift Style
abilities.rulesText: Before each Reactive Action you perform, you may Move 1. After each Action you perform, you gain 1 Speed token.

abilities.name: Weightless Style
abilities.rulesText: You do not take Fall Damage. Rubble does not give you Fatigue. All spaces are Empty spaces to you. You can move into and share a space with Copies, Walls, and other units. All spaces cost 1 Speed token to enter using Free Movement. Ignore all additional Speed token costs, from leaving Pits or moving diagonally or any other source.

abilities.name: Avalanche Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you may place up to three Walls into empty adjacent spaces. You can see and target enemies through Walls.

abilities.name: Crystal Style
abilities.rulesText: After you perform an Action with exactly one target, you deal 1 damage to all enemies adjacent to that target. The first time each turn one of your Copies is destroyed, you may place a Copy within range of your Original.

abilities.name: Frozen Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Iron tokens. After you Reduce a Hit, give 1 Weakness token to your attacker.

abilities.name: Heartless Style
abilities.rulesText: Whenever you give Tokens to an enemy, you heal 1. This Ability cannot heal you more than the Bleed Value in a single turn. Your Actions and Abilities are Unblockable by Shields.

abilities.name: Pressure Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, each enemy within range must pay 1 HP, then gain 1 Weakness token.

abilities.name: Chaotic Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: Before each Action you perform, you may Move 1. After your first Action on your turn, Move 1, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. At the end of each turn where you performed any Actions, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within range, then Move 2.

abilities.name: Circular Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: (Forced Movement is any Push or Pull effect) . After you take damage, pay HP, or are healed, you gain 1 Speed token. When you Bleed, gain 3 Speed tokens. After each Dice Action you perform, if it applied Forced Movement to an enemy, they must discard 1 Basic token, if they have any. If it applied Forced Movement to an ally, they heal 1. If it moved, swapped, or teleported you, you heal 1.

abilities.name: Dangerous Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you gain Shield 2. After your Shield absorbs from an enemy Action, you deal 1 damage to them. If it broke your Shield, deal 2 damage instead.

abilities.name: Ego Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: Once per turn, when an enemy you can see gains Basic tokens, you gain 1 Power token. You can Enhance a Hit one additional time.

abilities.name: Eternal Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, discard up to 2 Status tokens you hold; then, if you are Bleeding, you heal. At the end of your turn, choose up to two enemies within range and give them each 1 Weakness token.

abilities.name: Feral Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: After each Action you perform, if you are not Bleeding, pay 1 HP. At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Power tokens. When you Bleed, add a 4 to your Action Pool.

abilities.name: Grave Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: After you spend Control Tokens, you may Push 1 or Pull 1 to the enemy whose Action you Controlled. At the start of your turn, choose one: • Set your Range to 3-6 until your next turn. • Set your Range to 0-3 until your next turn.

abilities.name: Mountainous Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: You have Armor. When your Armor triggers, you gain 1 Iron token. When you gain Speed tokens, replace half of them (rounded down) with Iron tokens. You may spend 1 Iron token to take 1 less damage from any source (even Reduced Hits).

abilities.name: Mythical Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: Whenever you roll a 3 or less on the mythical d12 , re-roll it. After you roll your Action Dice during your turn, you may re-roll one die. Keep the new result, even if it is worse.

abilities.name: Persistant Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn and when you Bleed, add a 3 to your Action Pool. When you discard numbers from your Action Pool during the End Phase, you may keep up to two of them with a total value of 5 or less.

abilities.name: Secret Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, add 6 to your Action Pool, gain Shield 4, and you gain +3 maximum Range until the start of your next turn. This Ability triggers only once per fight. This Ability cannot trigger on Round 1.

abilities.name: Silent Freestyle
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you gain 2 Speed tokens. At the start of each Movement Phase, you may Move 1. You do not discard any Speed tokens during the End Phase.

abilities.name: Focused Angel
abilities.rulesText: Your Challenges are Unblockable By Shields. At the start of your turn, you may heal, then if you did, Challenge an enemy you can see and deal 1 damage to them. After you Challenge an enemy, deal 1 damage to them and heal 1.

abilities.name: Fused Angel
abilities.rulesText: Your Challenges are Unblockable By Shields. At the start of your turn, you may heal 2, then if you did, Challenge an enemy you can see. After you Challenge an enemy, you deal 1 damage to them.

abilities.name: Frantic Angel
abilities.rulesText: Your Challenges are Unblockable By Shields. At the start of this turn, you may heal, then if you did, Challenge an enemy you can see and deal 1 damage to them. Until your next turn, after you Challenge an enemy, deal 1 damage to them and heal 1.

abilities.name: Focused Cavalry
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you may Move up to 2, then you and each ally within range gains Shield 2.

abilities.name: Fused Cavalry
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you may Move up to 2, then you and each ally within range gains Shield 2.

abilities.name: Frantic Cavalry
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of this turn, you may Move up to 2, then you and each ally within range gains Shield 2.

abilities.name: Focused Cyborg
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 3 Basic Tokens of one type, 2 Basic tokens of a different type, and 1 Basic token of the final type.

abilities.name: Fused Cyborg
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Basic Tokens of one type, and 1 Basic token of each other type.

abilities.name: Frantic Cyborg
abilities.rulesText: At the start of this turn, you gain 3 Basic Tokens of one type, 2 Basic tokens of a different type, and 1 Basic token of the final type.

abilities.name: Focused Demon
abilities.rulesText: At the end of your turn, you gain 2 Chaos Tokens. At the start of each enemy turn, you may Pull yourself up to X spaces towards the active character, where X is the number of Chaos Tokens you hold.

abilities.name: Fused Demon
abilities.rulesText: At the end of your turn, you gain 1 Chaos Token. At the start of each enemy turn, you may Pull yourself up to X spaces towards the active character, where X is the number of Chaos Tokens you hold.

abilities.name: Frantic Demon
abilities.rulesText: At the end of this turn, you gain 2 Chaos Tokens. Until your next turn, at the start of each enemy turn, you may Pull yourself up to X spaces towards the active character, where X is the number of Chaos Tokens you hold.

abilities.name: Focused Flametongue
abilities.rulesText: Three times per turn, after you deal damage to an enemy, give them 2 Burning tokens.

abilities.name: Fused Flametongue
abilities.rulesText: Three times per turn, after you deal damage to an enemy, give them 1 Burning token.

abilities.name: Frantic Flametongue
abilities.rulesText: Until your next turn, three times per turn, after you deal damage to an enemy, give them 2 Burning tokens.

abilities.name: Focused Gunkata
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of your turn, you perform one Gunslinger Action of your choice without paying its cost, from among those available to you in your current Stance.

abilities.name: Fused Gunkata
abilities.rulesText: At the start -or- end of your turn, you perform one Gunslinger Action of your choice without paying its cost, from among those available to you in your current Stance.

abilities.name: Frantic Gunkata
abilities.rulesText: At the start and end of this turn, you perform one Gunslinger Action of your choice without paying its cost, from among those available to you in your current Stance.

abilities.name: Focused Phantom
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 4 Poltergeist Tokens.

abilities.name: Fused Phantom
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Poltergeist Tokens.

abilities.name: Frantic Phantom
abilities.rulesText: At the start of this turn, you gain 4 Poltergeist Tokens.

abilities.name: Focused Punk
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, add X to your Action Pool. X is equal to the damage on your current health bar, to a maximum of 13. If your health bar is full, X = 3.

abilities.name: Fused Punk
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, add X to your Action Pool. X is equal to half the damage on your current health bar, rounded up, to a maximum of 9. If your health bar is full, X = 2.

abilities.name: Frantic Punk
abilities.rulesText: At the start of this turn, add X to your Action Pool. X is equal to the damage on your current health bar, to a maximum of 13. If your health bar is full, X = 3.

abilities.name: Focused Teacher
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Mentor Tokens.

abilities.name: Fused Teacher
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Mentor Token.

abilities.name: Frantic Teacher
abilities.rulesText: At the start of this turn, you gain 2 Mentor Tokens.

abilities.name: Focused Trickster
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each turn, you may target 1 non-Unique token held by someone within range of you or your Copies, then choose one or both: Steal the chosen token; -and/or-Convert the chosen token into an Iron token.

abilities.name: Fused Trickster
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each allied turn, you may target 1 non-Unique token held by someone within range of you or your Copies, then choose one or both: Steal the chosen token; -and/or-Convert the chosen token into an Iron token.

abilities.name: Frantic Trickster
abilities.rulesText: Until your next turn, at the start of each turn, you may target 1 non-Unique token held by someone within range of you or your Copies, then choose one or both: Steal the chosen token; -and/or-Convert the chosen token into an Iron token.

abilities.name: Focused Underdog
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Luck Tokens. The first two times you take damage each turn, you gain 1 Basic token of your choice.

abilities.name: Fused Underdog
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Luck Token. The first time you take damage each turn, you gain 1 Basic token of your choice.

abilities.name: Frantic Underdog
abilities.rulesText: At the start of this turn, you gain 2 Luck Tokens. Until your next turn, the first two times you take damage each turn, you gain 1 Basic token of your choice.

abilities.name: Focused Wardancer
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the Action Phase of your turn, increase one of your numbers by 3, a different one of your numbers by 2, and one of your remaining numbers by 1. This can only increase a number to a maximum value of 9.

abilities.name: Fused Wardancer
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the Action Phase of your turn, increase one of your numbers by 2, and one of your other numbers by 1. This can only increase a number to a maximum value of 5.

abilities.name: Frantic Wardancer
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the Action Phase of this turn, increase one of your numbers by 3, a different one of your numbers by 2, and one of your remaining numbers by 1. This can only increase a number to a maximum value of 9.

abilities.name: Focused Winterblossom
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each turn, give 1 Weakness token to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.

abilities.name: Fused Winterblossom
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each allied turn, give 1 Weakness token to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.

abilities.name: Frantic Winterblossom
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each turn until your next turn, give 1 Weakness token to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.

abilities.name: Agile Build
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Speed tokens.

abilities.name: Bumbling Build
abilities.rulesText: At the end of any turn you took damage, you may move 1 space.

abilities.name: Mysterious Build
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you may place a Copy or Fog obstacle into an empty adjacent space.

abilities.name: Overpowering Build
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Power token.

abilities.name: Scheming Build
abilities.rulesText: At either the start or the end of your turn, you may place one Trap into an adjacent space.

abilities.name: Tough Build
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Iron token.

abilities.name: The Blur
abilities.rulesText: After you perform an Action, you may move one space.

abilities.name: The Giant
abilities.rulesText: You take up a 2x2 space on the battle grid. Your maximum range is increased by 1. You do not take Fall Damage. You can move over Walls. When you do, they become Rubble, and you gain one Fatigue token. You can Enhance a Hit one additional time. At the start of each of your turns, you gain 2 Power tokens.

abilities.name: The Immortal
abilities.rulesText: The first time you deal damage each turn, you Heal.

abilities.name: The Machine
abilities.rulesText: Your Stances are made up of one Style attached to two Forms. You never roll Green Action Dice. You cannot use Freestyles.

abilities.name: The Necromancer
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, place a Copy into an empty space within range. At the end of your turn, each of your Copies may Move 1, then each Copy deals 1 damage to one adjacent enemy.

abilities.name: The Swarm
abilities.rulesText: At the end of your turn, for each Copy you have in play, choose one: You gain 1 Power token; or you gain 1 Iron token; or you may move one space; or each of your Copies may move 1 space; or destroy a Copy to deal 1 damage to each enemy adjacent to it.

abilities.name: The Tank
abilities.rulesText: You have Armor. Your Armor blocks 10 damage the first time it triggers each turn. When you are Pushed or Pulled, you move one less space.

abilities.name: The Untouchable
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn and when you Bleed, you gain one Control Token. It only costs you 1 Control Token to Dodge an Action.

abilities.name: Chaos mechanics
abilities.rulesText: Chaos Token: This Unique Token is only used by the Demon. You may spend a Chaos Token to take a Reactive Action, as if you had spent a 4. Any Action that could be taken by spending a 4 is a valid option for a Chaos Token Action. Chaos Tokens are usable only once per turn.

abilities.name: Poltergeist mechanics
abilities.rulesText: Poltergeist Token: This Unique Token is used by the Phantom. When you pay the cost of an Action, you may spend Poltergeist Tokens to modify that Action. You can spend up to 2 additional Poltergeist Tokens per Action. If you spend multiple Poltergeist Tokens on an Action, each choice must be different. All modifications made using Poltergeist Tokens are considered to be a part of the Action they modified, and will trigger Abilities as such. X is equal to the number of Poltergeist Tokens spent on this Action. Choose X:  Increase the value of up to X different numbers listed in this Action by 1. This option cannot increase Damage or Choices. (“Choose 2” cannot become “Choose 3”, and “Deal 2 damage” cannot become “Deal 3 damage”)  Increase this Action’s maximum Range by +X.  Start of this Action: you teleport X.  Start of this Action: place Rubble into X spaces within range.  End of this Action: deal 1 damage to X enemies within range.  End of this Action: Push 1 or Pull 1 to X previous targets of this Action.

abilities.name: Mentor mechanics
abilities.rulesText: Mentor Token: Remember Your Training The active character heals 1, then performs a Unique Action available to their current Stance, without paying its cost. For the purposes of Gates or the value of X, use a value of 4. Usable once per turn, only during allies’ turns. Usable while you are Taken Out. The Teacher Abilities will still give you Mentor Tokens while you are Taken Out. A Teacher who has been struck down is more powerful than you can possible imagine. You can use Remember Your Training during your own turn, to perform one Unique Action you know for free. Remember Your Training doesn’t allow the active character to bypass Action limitations. For example, Extreme Violence is only usable once per turn. If you use Remember Your Training on an ally who has already used Extreme Violence this turn, they cannot choose Extreme Violence as their free Action. Mentor Token: This Unique token is only used by the Teacher. Mentor Tokens have the passive effect to improve your Heroic Spirit, letting you mentor your allies and improve their skills. Mentor Tokens may also be used to pay for Remember Your Training. Mentor Token Effect: If you are holding any Mentor Tokens, then when you give your Heroic Spirit, increase one of those numbers by 2. Then, repeat this for each Mentor Token you hold.

abilities.name: Luck mechanics
abilities.rulesText: Luck Tokens are a Unique Token used only by the Underdog. They protect you in unforeseen ways, allowing you to evade danger and keep up with the fight even in the worst situations. Once per turn, after any Action fully resolves, you may spend 1 Luck Token to Teleport 3 and Heal 1. 1 Luck Token may also be used to pay for (part of) any Token Action, in place of up to 3 Basic Tokens, 3 HP, or 3 Shield. This can be used as often as you have Luck Tokens and costs to reduce.

abilities.name: Training mechanics
abilities.rulesText: Training Token: This Unique Token is only used by Training Style. You can only use Training Tokens while you are the active character. After any Action you perform, if you still have numbers in your Action Pool, you may spend 1 Training token to increase one of those numbers by 2. You may only spend 1 Training token per Action. Training Tokens have a Token Cap of 4, instead of 10.

abilities.name: Control mechanics
abilities.rulesText: Control Token: A Unique token primarily granted by Control Form. After an enemy within your range declares and pays for an Action, but before they perform it, you have an opportunity to spend Control Tokens. You may spend 1 Control Token to Copy that Action, 2 Control Tokens to Dodge that Action, or 3 Control Tokens to Parry that Action. Control Tokens may only be used once per turn. Copy: After the Action resolves, you may perform the same Action immediately, as a Reactive Action. For X Values and Gates, use a value of 4. You cannot Copy an Action that is only usable once per turn. Dodge: You or an ally within your range become immune to the Action. That Action will deal no damage, give no tokens, cause no forced movement, and apply no other effects to the one who Dodged it. Parry: The Action is negated and immediately ends. Then, you deal 2 damage to the one who used the Parried Action, and may Move up to 2. Super Moves are not Actions, and cannot be Controlled.

abilities.name: Rapid Strike mechanics
abilities.rulesText: You gain 5 Speed tokens and 6 Rapid Strike tokens. As an Action during your own turn, or as a Reactive Action on an enemy’s turn, you may spend a Rapid Strike token to move one space, then deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.

abilities.name: Frantic Versatility
abilities.rulesText: When you are the active character, at the start of Phase 1 of your turn, you pick one Frantic Ability, one Style, and one Form, and combine them to create your Stance for the turn. You cannot pick an Ability, Style, or Form that you used on your previous turn.

abilities.name: Improved Focus
abilities.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Focus. Your dedication to your singular combat Archetype has paid off. Once per Round, after you see the results of any Action Dice you have rolled, you may re-roll up to three of them. You must take the new results, even if they are worse.

abilities.name: Greater Focus
abilities.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Focus. Gain the Fused Ability of your original Archetype - you now have both the Focused and Fused Abilities.

abilities.name: Focused Mastery
abilities.rulesText: you have achieved Focused Mastery, and your total physical control is beyond mortal comprehension. After you roll your Action Dice for the turn, select one number in your Action Pool and change it to any number you wish, between 1 and 9.

abilities.name: Improved Fusion
abilities.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Fusion. Your unusual fighting style has produced unusual results. Once per Round, after you see the results of your Action Dice, you may either add a 2 to your Action Pool, or increase the value of one number in your Action Pool by 1.

abilities.name: Greater Fusion
abilities.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Fusion. Choose one of your Fused Abilities and replace it with the Focused version of its Ability.

abilities.name: Fusion Mastery
abilities.rulesText: you have achieved Fusion Mastery, and your mental control over a variety of disciplines is beyond mortal comprehension. After you roll your Action Dice for your turn, select one number in your Action Pool with a value of 6 or less, and add a copy of that number to your Action Pool.

abilities.name: Improved Frenzy
abilities.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Frenzy. Your desperate tenacity keeps you one step ahead of everyone else. Choose one new Frantic Ability from an Archetype you do not yet have. Once per Round, after you see the results of your Action Dice, you may change your Style or your Archetype.

abilities.name: Greater Frenzy
abilities.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Frenzy. Choose one new Frantic Ability from an Archetype you do not yet have. Once per fight, you may choose to use two Frantic Abilities on the same turn.

abilities.name: Frenzy Mastery
abilities.rulesText: you have achieved Frenzy Mastery, and your explosive potential is beyond comprehension. After you roll your Action Dice for your turn, roll the mythical d12 and you may replace one number in your Action Pool with the result.

abilities.name: Improved Warrior
abilities.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Warrior. You must choose a Warrior’s Path. At the start of combat, you gain the benefit of your Warrior’s Path.

abilities.name: Greater Warrior
abilities.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Warrior. Your Warrior’s Path now also triggers at the start of your turn.

abilities.name: A Warrior’s Death
abilities.rulesText: you have achieved A Warrior’s Death, and will never be taken out quietly. When you fall, you go down swinging. Once per fight, after you fall to zero HP: Add a 10 to your Action Pool, then trigger your Warrior’s Path, then immediately spend that 10 to perform a Dice Action. After this Action finishes resolving, if you are still at zero HP, you become Taken Out as normal.

abilities.name: Path of the Badger
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, you Move up to 3, then you may deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

abilities.name: Path of the Elephant
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, you gain 2 Iron Tokens.

abilities.name: Path of the Gecko
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, choose one: you Heal -or- you remove up to 3 Status Tokens you hold.

abilities.name: Path of the Monkey
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, you add a 1 to your Action Pool.

abilities.name: Path of the Rabbit
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, you gain 4 Speed Tokens.

abilities.name: Path of the Tiger
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, you gain 2 Power Tokens.

abilities.name: Path of the Turtle
abilities.rulesText: When triggered, you gain temporary Armor.

superMoves.name: Heaven’s Piledriver
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 6 damage to an adjacent enemy. That enemy cannot use Free Movement until after the end of their next turn.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Siren’s Scream
superMoves.rulesText: Challenge and deal 2 damage to all enemies. Then, you gain an 8-point Shield.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Call In The Cavalry
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to all enemies, then deal 2 damage to all enemies.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Inspire Perfection
superMoves.rulesText: Remove up to 4 Status tokens from yourself and each ally you can see. Heal, give 2 Power tokens, and give 2 Iron tokens to each ally you can see, including yourself.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Draining Knuckle
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to an adjacent enemy, and they discard all Basic Tokens they hold. Then, you gain 2 Power tokens, 2 Iron tokens, and 3 Speed tokens.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Drive Install
superMoves.rulesText: You gain 6 Power tokens, 6 Iron tokens, and 6 Speed tokens. For the rest of this fight, you can spend 1 more Power token and 1 more Iron token per hit. For the rest of this fight, you only discard 1 Speed token at the end of each turn, instead of 3 of them.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Unending Despair
superMoves.rulesText: Target an adjacent enemy. Give them 4 Burning tokens, 3 Fatigue tokens, and 2 Weakness tokens. You gain 2 Iron tokens, 2 Power tokens, 2 Speed tokens, and 2 Chaos tokens.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Dancing Mad
superMoves.rulesText: Teleport 3, then deal 2 damage to an adjacent enemy. You may repeat this as many times as you like. After you damage the same enemy twice, you deal 1 damage to all enemies within Range 1-3, then this Super Move ends.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Erupting Burning Fist
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 4 damage and Push 4 to an adjacent enemy, then give them Burning Tokens until they hold 6.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Watch The World Burn
superMoves.rulesText: Place a Trap under each enemy you can see, then give each of those enemies 2 Burning tokens and 3 Fatigue tokens.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Sniping Point
superMoves.rulesText: Your maximum range is infinite, until the end of this Round. Then, deal 7 damage to an enemy within range.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Lead Rain
superMoves.rulesText: Choose an enemy within range. Deal 1 damage to that enemy and all adjacent enemies, then deal 1 damage to that enemy and all adjacent enemies, then deal 1 damage to that enemy and all adjacent enemies, then deal 1 damage to that enemy and all adjacent enemies, then deal 1 damage to that enemy and all adjacent enemies.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Poltergeist Panic
superMoves.rulesText: You may move each Rubble or Trap you can see, up to three spaces each. Each must be moved into a different space - you cannot stack obstacles on top of each other. After you’ve finished moving obstacles, every enemy standing on an obstacle takes 3 damage, even if it wasn’t an obstacle you moved onto them.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Arcana Install
superMoves.rulesText: You gain 6 Poltergeist Tokens. Until the end of this Round, you can spend up to 3 Poltergeist Tokens per Action, instead of only 2 per Action. Until the end of this combat, at the start of your turn, you gain 2 Poltergeist Tokens.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Knuckle Sandwich
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 5 damage to an adjacent enemy, then give them 4 Weakness tokens and your Challenge token. Then, Push them 3.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Everybody, Get ‘Em!
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to an adjacent enemy. Then, each of your allies in play (other than yourself) may each deal 3 damage to one enemy within their range.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: My Final Technique
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 99 damage to an enemy within range, then remove yourself from play for the rest of combat. You cannot come back.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Transcendant Spirit
superMoves.rulesText: This is only usable while you are Taken Out, and does not require any numbers to perform. When you pass on your Heroic Spirit, you may declare you are using this Super Move. If you do, instead of rolling your Action Dice this turn, give them the maximum number each of those dice could have generated. Then, add an 8 to their Action Pool, give them a 4-point Shield, and they heal.

superMoves.name: Funny Little Box Of Pain
superMoves.rulesText: Target an enemy at Range 2. Push everyone adjacent to the target one space. Then, place Walls into each space adjacent to the target, place a Deadly Trap beneath them, and give them 5 Fatigue tokens.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

grantedObject.rulesText: The Deadly Trap islike a regular Trap, except for two things: Whenever it triggers, it deals 2 damage instead of 1 damage; and the Deadly Trap cannot be removed by Actions or Abilities.

superMoves.name: Steal Strength
superMoves.rulesText: Target an adjacent character. They discard all tokens they hold, and you gain Iron tokens equal to the number of tokens discarded.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Lucky Hit
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to an adjacent enemy. Then, that enemy discards all Basic tokens they hold, discards all Shields they hold, and cannot have Armor or Shields for the rest of this Round.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Hyper Install
superMoves.rulesText: You gain 3 Luck tokens and you heal. For the rest of this Round, you gain a benefit at the start of every single turn, depending on whose turn it is. If it is an enemy turn, you gain 1 Iron token and 1 Speed token. If it is an allied turn, you gain 1 Power token and heal 1. If it is your turn, you gain both effects: gain 1 Iron token, 1 Power token, 1 Speed token, and you heal 1.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Become My Canvas
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, ignoring Armor and Shields. Then, deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, ignoring Armor and Shields. Then, deal 3 damage to an enemy within range, ignoring Armor and Shields.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Lightning Drop
superMoves.rulesText: Teleport to any space on the map. Then, deal 4 damage to an adjacent enemy. Then, deal 2 damage to all enemies within Range 1-4.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: You Are Nothing.
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to an enemy within range, Pull them up to 3, then give them Weakness tokens until they hold 6.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Blizzard
superMoves.rulesText: Until the end of this Round, increase your maximum range by 2. Also until the end of this Round, at the end of every turn, you give 1 Fatigue token and 1 Weakness token to every enemy within range, then you may move 1 space.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Instant Motion
superMoves.rulesText: You gain 5 Speed tokens and 6 Rapid Strike tokens. As an Action during your own turn, or as a Reactive Action on an enemy’s turn, you may spend a Rapid Strike token to move one space, then deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Toss Aside
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to all enemies within range, then push all of those enemies up to 5 spaces each.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Burning Blood
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to an enemy within range, then you heal. For the rest of this Round, after you take damage, deal 1 damage and give 1 Burning token to the enemy that dealt damage to you.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Smash
superMoves.rulesText: Deal 10 damage to an enemy within range.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Immortal Army
superMoves.rulesText: Summon up to 6 Copies within range. Then, each of those Copies may move one or two spaces, then they each deal 1 damage to one adjacent enemy. Iron tokens can be used to reduce this damage.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Crawl Into View
superMoves.rulesText: Place 4 Copies into spaces you can see. Then, each of those Copies may immediately take an Action as if you had spent a 3 .

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Armor Install
superMoves.rulesText: Until the end of this Round, your Armor can be triggered twice per turn, and your Armor is not spent when it reduces a 1 damage hit to zero. Until the end of the next Round, opponents can only spend 1 Iron token to reduce your hits, and Weakness tokens only reduce your damage by 1 instead of 2.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

superMoves.name: Lockdown Protocol
superMoves.rulesText: Gain 4 Control tokens. For the rest of this fight, after you spend any Control tokens, deal 1 damage to each enemy within your range.

cost.text: Two matching numbers, each 3 or higher

features.name: Greater Focus
features.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Focus. Gain the Fused Ability of your original Archetype - you now have both the Focused and Fused Abilities.

features.name: Focused Mastery
features.rulesText: you have achieved Focused Mastery, and your total physical control is beyond mortal comprehension. After you roll your Action Dice for the turn, select one number in your Action Pool and change it to any number you wish, between 1 and 9.

features.name: Improved Fusion
features.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Fusion. Your unusual fighting style has produced unusual results. Once per Round, after you see the results of your Action Dice, you may either add a 2 to your Action Pool, or increase the value of one number in your Action Pool by 1.

features.name: Greater Fusion
features.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Fusion. Choose one of your Fused Abilities and replace it with the Focused version of its Ability.

features.name: Fusion Mastery
features.rulesText: you have achieved Fusion Mastery, and your mental control over a variety of disciplines is beyond mortal comprehension. After you roll your Action Dice for your turn, select one number in your Action Pool with a value of 6 or less, and add a copy of that number to your Action Pool.

features.name: Improved Frenzy
features.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Frenzy. Your desperate tenacity keeps you one step ahead of everyone else. Choose one new Frantic Ability from an Archetype you do not yet have. Once per Round, after you see the results of your Action Dice, you may change your Style or your Archetype.

features.name: Greater Frenzy
features.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Frenzy. Choose one new Frantic Ability from an Archetype you do not yet have. Once per fight, you may choose to use two Frantic Abilities on the same turn.

features.name: Frenzy Mastery
features.rulesText: you have achieved Frenzy Mastery, and your explosive potential is beyond comprehension. After you roll your Action Dice for your turn, roll the mythical d12 and you may replace one number in your Action Pool with the result.

features.name: Improved Warrior
features.rulesText: At level 3, you gain Improved Warrior. You must choose a Warrior’s Path. At the start of combat, you gain the benefit of your Warrior’s Path.

features.name: Greater Warrior
features.rulesText: At level 7, you gain Greater Warrior. Your Warrior’s Path now also triggers at the start of your turn.

features.name: A Warrior’s Death
features.rulesText: you have achieved A Warrior’s Death, and will never be taken out quietly. When you fall, you go down swinging. Once per fight, after you fall to zero HP: Add a 10 to your Action Pool, then trigger your Warrior’s Path, then immediately spend that 10 to perform a Dice Action. After this Action finishes resolving, if you are still at zero HP, you become Taken Out as normal.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Badger
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, you Move up to 3, then you may deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Elephant
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, you gain 2 Iron Tokens.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Gecko
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, choose one: you Heal -or- you remove up to 3 Status Tokens you hold.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Monkey
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, you add a 1 to your Action Pool.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Rabbit
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, you gain 4 Speed Tokens.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Tiger
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, you gain 2 Power Tokens.

warriorPaths.name: Path of the Turtle
warriorPaths.rulesText: When triggered, you gain temporary Armor.
